messages:
pagerbot: [INCIDENT] P1 continuous-batch latency cliff detected - sudden tail latency spike and queue depth increase for model gpt-7-mini-prod. Alert frequency high (80 alerts / 5m). Link: https://incidents/redwood/1765551234

oncall_sre_morgan: I'm taking this. Looking at dashboards — queue depth jumped, microbatch sizes collapsed to mostly 1-2, KV cache miss rate >95%. Marking as impacting. Will triage autoscaler, batching controller, and kv cache stats.

ana_pl: I got the page. ETA ~2m. Initial read: recent config change toggled prefix cache for that model around 02:14 UTC. Could be related.

ev an_r: Any customer errors reported?

support_beryl: Two customers opened support tickets reporting high latency/timeouts. One customer saw 5xx rate jump from 0.1% -> 3% during the spike. Already notified account teams.

morgan: Running quick probes now:
```bash
# batching controller quick checks
kubectl -n inference logs svc/batcher-0 --tail=200 | grep -i microbatch_size
# kv cache metrics
curl -sS http://metrics.local/kvcache | jq '.evictions, .hit_rate, .size'
```

morgan: Probe results: microbatch_size_distribution ~ 60% at 1, 30% at 2, 10% >=4. KV cache: evictions/sec ~1200, hit_rate ~0.04, size dropped ~30% in last 60s.

sri_ops: That eviction rate is massive. Any recent deployment/config?

deploy-bot: Deployment gpt-7-mini-prod rollout completed by devin at 02:14 UTC. Config highlights: prefix_cache=true, cache_capacity=8GB, continuous_batching.window_ms=12

ana_pl: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) reduce continuous_batching.window_ms from 12 -> 4 to force faster flushes, 2) cap microbatch_max_size to 8 so batches don't over-wait, 3) temporarily disable prefix_cache on serving nodes. Prepare hotpatch plan.

morgan: I'll apply change to a small canary (3 pods) first. If metrics look good, we'll scale rollout.

morgan: Applying canary patch now:
```yaml
# patch snippet
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        cb-window-ms: 4
        cb-max-microbatch: 8
        prefix-cache-enabled: false
```

morgan: Canary pods restarted and are healthy. Monitoring metrics.

ana_pl: Watching kv metrics and batch distribution.

morgan: 60s after patch (canary): microbatch distribution moved to ~35% at 1, 50% at 2, 15% >=4. KV evictions/sec dropped from ~1200 -> ~120. Hit rate improving to ~0.28.

support_beryl: Traced customer requests routed to canary — their p99 improved and timeouts reduced. Sending interim update to affected customers.

ev an_r: Can we route a small % of traffic to a non-cache variant as fallback during rollout?

sri_ops: Yes, we have a compatible variant gpt-7-mini-fast that does not enable prefix cache. Recommend routing 20% as additional safety.

morgan: Initiating gradual rollout: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with automated checks on kv_evictions and p99 latency.

pagerbot: [CHANGE] Gradual rollout triggered by oncall_sre_morgan at 1765551500.

ana_pl: After 8 minutes into rollout: cluster-wide evictions down ~85%, p99 latency reduced from ~1.8s -> ~0.35s, microbatch distribution stabilized. Recommend continue to 100% with 2m pause windows.

morgan: Rolling remaining pods in 25% increments, pausing 2m between steps.

morgan: Full rollout completed and stable at 1765551820. Post-rollout metrics show stable queues, low evictions, and restored hit rate.

support_beryl: Customer impact summary: two customers experienced elevated p95/p99 for ~12 minutes; one customer had a transient increase in 5xxs. No data loss or persisted errors. Incident update sent to customers and account teams.

ana_pl: Immediate follow-ups / action items:
- Create incident ticket and schedule blameless RCA.
- Reproduce under load test with prefix cache enabled to validate eviction/fragmentation behavior.
- Add runtime guardrail: when eviction rate spikes above threshold, automatically back off cache admission and lower batching window to prevent microbatch collapse.
- Add deploy pipeline canary test for toggling prefix cache under simulated high concurrency.

ev an_r: I'll open the postmortem and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml.

morgan: Handoff to next oncall @ana_pl — I'm signing off, last check-in at 1765551824.

pagerbot: Incident mitigated and closed by oncall_sre_morgan at 1765551824.
